meta.face: A man of about seventy with a long, high-domed head and a long, bony face — a very high, receding forehead with a deep brow, a strong, prominent aquiline nose with a high bridge, deep-set, pale eyes under a heavy brow ridge with thin grey brows, hollow cheeks, a long upper lip and a jutting chin; thin, straight grey hair left long behind the ears, falling to the nape; a very short, close-cropped grey beard along the jaw and chin (not full); a quiet, thoughtful gaze lifted from the book.
meta.basis: No likeness survives from life. André Thevet's engraved portrait (1584) gives the type followed here: a high, receding forehead, a strong aquiline nose, hollow cheeks, long grey hair at the nape and a short stubble beard; the black Benedictine habit and pallium are his as monk of Bec and archbishop of Canterbury.
